notes:
V3.1.3 — Bot Market as a standalone tab.

What changed:
• 'MORE BOTS' is back to being the local bot manager — only the four sections that belong there (ACTIVE / AVAILABLE / SILENCED / UPLOAD CUSTOM + a single 🛒 Open Bot Market launcher card).
• The full marketplace moved to its own tab, hidden by default. It appears in the tab bar after you click '🛒 Open Bot Market' from MORE BOTS, and has its own ✕ Close market button that hides it again.
• Inside the market, sub-nav pills replace the four scrolling sections: ✨ Featured · 🎯 For You · 🔍 Browse all · 📊 My published. Only one section's results are visible at a time so the page actually breathes.
• Cards are bigger and richer: name + ⭐ FEATURED / ✦ RECO badges + price (◊ N credits or FREE) + description (always present, multi-line) + a 4-column stat strip (philosophy / win rate / downloads / rating) + price + install button.
• Search + filters live in a single sticky-feel block at the top — they apply to whichever sub-section is active.
• ⬆ Publish a bot button promoted to the market header (still works from MORE BOTS' drag-and-drop too).

No server changes — purely a UX restructure on top of v3.1.2's endpoints.
